course_name_original: MABB510 – Praktisches Studiensemester Vor- und Nachbereitung
course_name_en: MABB510 – Practical Study Semester Preparation and Follow-up
prerequisites: Admission to the main study period

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be taught efficient planning and execution of projects.
Additionally, the fundamentals of scientific work in conducting experiments or similar will be presented.
This should enable them to process tasks and projects in their practical semester in the best possible way.
The subsequent report and oral presentation about their practical semester also serves as preparation for the Bachelor's thesis, as the report is based on the fundamental structure of final theses.

syllabus_topics: Efficient planning and execution of projects
Case study methods for project planning
Project controlling of essential project parameters (time, costs, quality, performance)
Representation of measurement results and theoretical calculations in scientific diagrams
Obtaining and sorting background information through scientific research
Presentation of one or more projects worked on during the practical semester
Current topics and developments in the field and environment of mechanical engineering

assessment_methods.method: Participation in final workshop and final meeting
Ungraded oral examination, presentation, or term paper (content varies by guest lecturer)

assessment_rules: MABB 511 Project Management requires keeping a project handbook and participating in the final workshop and meeting. MABB 512 Scientific Work is assessed by an ungraded 60-minute written exam. MABB 513 Follow-up is assessed by an ungraded colloquium. For MABB 514 Guest Lectures, the study performance (ungraded oral examination/presentation or term paper) will be specified at the beginning of the semester.
